name: hgi_sm_xl2_ctlw_n7

job.purpose: Opt-in nat2 client candidate. Actual RD_LAT7 metadata stage required for uniformly pin-registered physical bank. Production defaults/frozen d4 stay RD_LAT6 until atomic client/compiler/physical revision and all bank native PASS.
job.structural_change: ctlw (H-NETLIST/H-DIE option A, 10-16): x-load issuer ot_static_cmd_target (MODE 1, CW 108, TGT_PIN 1, LEAD 8, one 128x256 calendar SRAM on its own hard clock entry clk_cal) folded into the ctl die master as pin-registered soft logic; face takes the raw F20 broadcast + tgt strap, x_v/x fields/x_busy/x_fault internal. Includes cl2e (need(eb2)/last-beat registered one edge ahead, cl2d TT -92.5). F20 lock bench: commands only through the real host ingress, fire = launch + 2 + LEAD + at; MUT6 (late fire) FAILs. | n7: literal RD_LAT7, actual metadata-depth stage, same slot and all normal pins. Atomic adoption only after nat2 native proof; no inherited6 view.

slot_change_request: ctl die master with the x-load issuer folded in (H-NETLIST/H-DIE option A 10-16): same 345.6 x 345.6 slot as ctl, N face x_* (117 in + 2 out) replaced by the F20 bus + tgt strap + status (328 in + 3 out); one 128x256 calendar SRAM inside
floorplan_note: cl2a EARLY_FAIL_HOLD at CTS: one clk root of 16,281 sinks (>15k) entering at the N-face corner, input pin-flop clock arrival 375..526 ps vs the boundary reference (IO hold class: bq_c[1984] on the far S face stuck at -20.8 ps). cl2b: two related phase-0 roots (clk core ~9k, clk_eg egress ~7.3k: rw / BD-beat pin capture, beat select, xw pins), both entering at the N-face centre, balanced sink clustering (size 16, 30 um, -balance_levels). cl2c: BD beat select exported one-hot from ctl (bdring cl2a TT -78.67: bsb replica -> 13-way decode -> 2,048-b mux, 292-ps slew buffer tree); ring leaf keeps 64 pin-register replicas of the 26-b one-hot, AND-OR select; same edges. ctlw (10-16): issuer calendar SRAM (94.8 x 41.0) at NW below the N pin band (x 30.24, y 270.0), west of the N-centre clock entries, next to the F20 pins and the ctl command flops. ctlw r2: the calendar SRAM clock is a hard entry clk_cal (N face x 77.8, above the macro), CTS roots clk/clk_eg reach standard cells only (hybrid_entries; the multiple_cts_roots gate refused a root reaching the SRAM).

pin_regs.reason: OWNER RULE 19:50 met in RTL (rtl/hbm_accel/generic/peers/ot_hgi_sm_xload_static_cl2.sv, x-load cl2 rewritten for this rule; +2 edges accepted by the coordinator): inputs land in pin flops c_base..c_xb / cmd_v (x_*), rr_c (rr), rw (rwq), bq_c (bq_d), qo_*_c/qf_*_c (quantiser flags); every output is a register (q_v/q_s, x_busy/x_fault/x_done, xw_*, c_d/c_wce/c_mhi/c_mlo/c_wa, r_ce/r_a, l_d, qv_*, r_wsel/zlo/zhi, ea/eb2, lane_en, rn); a recipe-3 register would add a second stage on every port.; ctlw: the F20 bus / tgt land in ot_static_cmd_target pin flops (cv/dv/lv/target_q/addr_q/data_q/base_q/limit_q/loops_q/tgt_q), configured/fault/active are its status flops
